# onepassword_document (Resource)

Manage 1Password document items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onepassword_document" "example" {
  vault = "Engineering"
  name  = "Example Document"

  document {
    filename = "example.txt"
    content  = file("${path.module}/example.txt")
  }

  sections = {
    "metadata" = {
      label = "Metadata"
      fields = [
        {
          label = "owner"
          type  = "text"
          value = "Example Owner"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Item title.
- `vault` (String) 1Password vault title.

### Optional

- `document` (Block, Optional) Document content. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--document))
- `note` (String) Item note.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (deprecated in favor of note).
- `sections` (Attributes) Item sections map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `version` (Number) Version trigger to refresh ephemeral values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
